faq.title: Technical & Engineering Answers
faq.desc: All key information structured about our materials, local regulations in Miami-Dade and delivery processes.

items.q: Does Dario's comply with the Florida Building Code (FBC) for hurricanes?
items.a: Yes. We strictly design and weld all our security grilles, gates and railings complying with the Florida Building Code (FBC) and ASCE 7 wind load requirements for storm and hurricane prone zones, with wind resistance capacities up to 175 mph depending on the sector.

items.q: What are the differences between traditional blacksmith paint and Powder Coating?
items.a: Conventional paint wears and peels quickly due to the Miami sun. We apply thermoset electrostatic powder paint (Powder Coating) baked at 400°F. This generates a thick, uniform and flexible shield that resists impacts, UV rays and moisture without rusting the base metal.

items.q: What service areas do you cover in South Florida?
items.a: Our local coverage area for measurement, delivery and installation includes Miami, Coral Gables, Doral, Brickell, Pinecrest, Key Biscayne, South Miami, Kendall and surrounding areas of Miami-Dade County.

items.q: What kind of maintenance do your metal gates and grilles require?
items.a: Structures with a galvanized finish and powder coating require minimal maintenance. We recommend washing them every 3 to 6 months with clean water and a mild non-abrasive soap to remove deposits of dust, sea salt and weathering impurities.

items.q: What is the process to request a technical quote for my residence or business?
items.a: You can contact us via web form or by clicking on the WhatsApp link. Send us preliminary measurements, photos of the installation area or aesthetic references. We will evaluate the information and give you a precise proposal. Subsequently, we make a visit to verify dimensions.
